description: This file contains JavaScript functions related to setting return values for purchase order and product selection, interacting with the parent window's DOM elements in the context of the vtiger CRM system. It also includes a script import for Inventory.js.

methods.name: set_return(product_id, product_name)
methods.description: Sets product ID and name in the parent window for purchase order context.

methods.name: set_return_specific(product_id, product_name)
methods.description: Sets product ID and name using getOpenerObj for specific fields related to purchase order.

methods.name: set_return_formname_specific(formname, product_id, product_name)
methods.description: Sets product ID and name in a specific form context within the parent window.

methods.name: set_return_todo(product_id, product_name)
methods.description: Sets product ID and name for a to-do item in the parent window.
